cancel.notCancelable: This subscription can't be canceled here: it has already ended, or it isn't billed through Stripe.
cancel.notConnected: Stripe isn't connected, so ReputeCast can't cancel the subscription. Cancel it in Stripe instead.
connect.keyFormat: That doesn't look like a Stripe key. Restricted keys start with rk_live_ or rk_test_.
connect.keyRejected: Stripe says this key isn't valid. It may have been rolled, deleted or copied only in part. Copy it again from Stripe › Developers › API keys.
connect.modeConnected: A {mode, select, live {live} test {test} other {{mode}}} key is already connected. Replace it from Earn › Settings › Payments.
connect.otherAccount: This key belongs to another Stripe account. Use a key from {account}, or disconnect first.
connect.otherMode: This connection uses a {mode, select, live {live} test {test} other {{mode}}} key. Paste a key that starts with rk_{mode}_.
connect.replaceMissing: The new key is missing {count, plural, one {# permission} other {# permissions}}, {first} among them. Edit the key in Stripe, then try again.
connect.secretFormat: A webhook signing secret starts with whsec_. Copy it from the endpoint in Stripe › Developers › Webhooks.
connect.secretKey: Secret keys give full access to your Stripe account, including payouts. Create a restricted key instead. Nothing was sent to Stripe and the key wasn't stored.
connect.taxOff: Stripe Tax isn't turned on for {account}. Turn it on in Stripe, or leave tax at checkout off.
connect.taxOffAny: Stripe Tax isn't turned on for the connected account. Turn it on in Stripe first.
connect.unavailable: Payments aren't available right now: Stripe isn't answering. Nothing changed. Try again in a few minutes.
connect.unreachable: Stripe can't reach {host}. Set REPUTECAST_PUBLIC_URL to an address on the internet, or add the webhook by hand.
connect.webhookFirst: Set up the webhook first. Without it, paid status can't stay in step with Stripe.
grant.already: This contact already has complimentary access. Change it instead.
grant.contact: Pick a contact of this workspace.
grant.tier: Pick a tier of this workspace.
grant.until: Pick an end date, or no end date.
grant.untilPast: The end date has to be in the future.
import.column: This file has no column called “{column}”.

import.compNote.message: {source, select, csv {Paid-through date from the CSV file, with no subscription in Stripe} other {Paid-through date from the {platform} export, with no subscription in Stripe}}
import.compNote.note: the note of complimentary access an import gives; source is csv for a CSV file, platform names the others (Substack, Ghost, beehiiv, Kit)

import.conflict: Pick the Stripe customer {email} pays with, or skip the row.

import.consent.message: Imported from {source, select, csv {a CSV file} other {{platform}}} (paid member)
import.consent.note: consent evidence of an imported paid member; source is csv for a CSV file, platform names the others (Substack, Ghost, beehiiv, Kit)

import.noEmail: No email column found. Pick the column that holds addresses.
import.notConnected: Stripe isn't connected. Connect Stripe first: the import matches paid members with their Stripe subscriptions.
import.notMatched: Match the rows with Stripe first.
import.size: The file is empty or larger than {mb} MB.

import.source.message: Imported from {source, select, csv {a CSV file} other {{platform}}}
import.source.note: a paid member's source; source is csv for a CSV file, platform names the others

import.tooMany: The file has more than {count, number} rows. Split it and import each part.
import.unmappedPrice: {price} ({id}) isn't mapped to a tier yet. Map it, or keep it as a legacy price.
import.unreadable: This file couldn't be read. Upload the CSV, or the zip, exactly as the platform exported it.
notify.attention.key_rejected.title: Stripe rejected the restricted key

notify.attention.key_rejected.body.message: {account}: Stripe stopped accepting the key on {at, date} at {at, time}, so paid status isn't updating. Replace the key in Earn › Settings › Payments.
notify.attention.key_rejected.body.note: account: the Stripe account's name; at: when, in the workspace's time zone

notify.attention.webhook_missing.title: The Stripe webhook was deleted

notify.attention.webhook_missing.body.message: {account}: the webhook endpoint is gone from Stripe ({at, date}, {at, time}), so paid status isn't updating. Register it again in Earn › Settings › Payments.
notify.attention.webhook_missing.body.note: at: when it was found missing, in the workspace's time zone

notify.attention.webhook_silent.title: No Stripe events for a day

notify.attention.webhook_silent.body.message: {account}: no event has arrived for 24 hours (checked {at, date} at {at, time}). The hourly check still reads missed events. Look at the webhook in Earn › Settings › Payments.
notify.attention.webhook_silent.body.note: at: when it was checked, in the workspace's time zone

notify.failedTitle: {count, plural, one {# payment failed} other {# payments failed}} in the last day

notify.importTitle.note: source is csv for a CSV file, platform names the others (Substack, Ghost, beehiiv, Kit)
